description_expanded:
Cassine Village in Seagrove Beach

.3 miles from One Seagrove Beach Access

5-minute stroll to stunning coastal dune lake

2 Community pools!

3 bedrooms, 3 baths

3 bikes!

Gas grill

Outdoor shower

4-star restaurants

Surfin’ Cowboy by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Surfin' Cowboy is a beautiful home, ideal for up to 8 guests craving coastal relaxation, 30A adventure, and the perfect Emerald Coast experience. The white picket fence adds a charming nuance. This gorgeous 3-bedroom, 3-bath getaway, built in 2020, is just a short stroll from the sugar-white sands of Seagrove Beach. Eastern Lake is close, too, and a must-visit. Tucked in tranquil Cassine Village, the white picket fence says, “We’re home!” You’ll have access to two pools, tennis courts, breathtaking nature trails(!), plus shops and restaurants just steps away. On the main floor, the delightfully decorated, open living, dining, and kitchen area is designed for easy, breezy gatherings. The kitchen’s fully equipped for whipping up meals, with bar seating for three and a dining table for six. The first-floor guest bedroom features a queen bed, a twin XL bunk, and a walk-in closet. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a queen bed, an en-suite bathroom with a soaking tub, dual vanity, and a private balcony.

The guest room has three twin XL beds and its own bathroom, Colorful and inviting, the massive screened-in porch out back is a wonderful space and a favorite hangout spot. Enjoy the ping pong table, custom bar, and comfy seating— all framed by lush greenery for that extra dose of privacy. The front porches on both levels are ideal for sipping coffee or unwinding in the fresh air. Outside, there’s space for three cars, an outdoor hot-and-cold shower, a gas grill, and a beach gear closet stocked with chairs. Dining spots, a local seafood market, and shops are just a short walk away. Seaside is two miles down the road, perfect for a scenic bike ride. Check out The Big Chill for live entertainment and food, or take an easy pedal over to Deer Lake State Park to explore the untouched beauty of 30A’s beaches and rare dune lakes. Seagrove Beach is in the middle of everything, making Surfin' Cowboy the ideal launchpad for exploring all of 30A’s vibrant communities. A truly magnificent home. Overview: - .3 miles from One Seagrove Beach Access - 3 bedrooms, 3 baths - 1500 sq ft - 2 community pools - 3 bikes included - Gas grill - Wi-Fi - Table tennis - Outdoor shower - Bassinet available Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Guest room: Twin/queen built-in bunk, hall bath, TV SECOND FLOOR - Primary bedroom: Queen bed, private bath, private balcony, TV - Bunk room: Twin/twin bunk, single twin bed, private bath, TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
